links.title: Chapter 24 - Text-to-Speech and Speech Recognition Engines, Automate the Boring Stuff with Python, 3rd Ed
links.why: The course textbook's own chapter, free online: pyttsx3, Whisper, subtitle files, yt-dlp and the practice programs.

links.title: wave - Read and write WAV files
links.why: The standard module that reads and writes the WAV files pyttsx3 saves: channels, sample width, frame rate and frames.

links.title: pathlib - Object-oriented filesystem paths
links.why: Path.glob and PurePath.match, which find the downloaded file whatever its extension.

links.title: json - JSON encoder and decoder
links.why: json.dumps and json.load, used for Whisper's JSON output and for the video metadata file.

links.title: What's New In Python 3.13
links.why: The list of standard-library modules removed in 3.13, among them aifc, audioop, sunau, chunk and sndhdr.

links.title: PEP 594 - Removing dead batteries from the standard library
links.why: Why the old audio modules were removed and that the wave module stays.

links.title: WebVTT: The Web Video Text Tracks Format
links.why: The specification of the VTT file: the WEBVTT line, cue timings and the optional hours in a time stamp.

links.title: SubRip - Wikipedia
links.why: The SRT file format: numbered blocks, times with a comma before the milliseconds, and a blank line between blocks.

links.title: openai-whisper - PyPI
links.why: The project page of the package the chapter installs as openai-whisper.

links.title: yt-dlp - PyPI
links.why: The project page of yt-dlp, with its options and the note that it follows the video sites' changes.

links.title: pyttsx3 - Text-to-speech x-platform (documentation of version 2.6)
links.why: The package's own documentation of the Engine, Voice and driver interfaces; it describes version 2.6 of 2021, older than the 2.99 read for this chapter.
